summary: Iteration 4 — validated the 2 new physics features (SPL grid in /stage-map 3D view + J-Array physical prediction in /toolkit) plus slider reactivity + full 15-route regression + iteration_1/2/3 fixes. All PASS. No NaN/Infinity, no console app errors, 4 new testids resolve to numeric/non-empty values, and both physics engines react correctly to slider changes.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/stage-map/index.tsx L778-809: splGrid useMemo is well-scoped (dependencies: pins, room, geo) and only builds sources for tops/subs/delay — monitors are correctly excluded (they aim backward, not into the audience grid). Fixed 20x28 grid @ 1 kHz / 1.6m yPlane is a sensible default. Returns undefined when there are no PA sources so the KPI card is conditionally hidden.

src/pages/toolkit/index.tsx L221-231: solveLineArray() useMemo re-runs on every slider change. Reactivity confirmed live (boxes 8→12 shifts spread 10.7→9.9 dB, far 30→60 shifts targets 27→7m → 55→7m and spread to 14.1 dB).

Minor UX: the 'Predicción física ISO 9613' KPI card in /stage-map renders 'Uniform 70%' which is high enough to be colored #00FF9E — visual state matches the physical meaning. However the SPL Máx = 133 dB is only credible with the demo gear; verify that computeSplGrid still guards against pathological sources (SPL@1m > 145 dB) to avoid saturating audiences visually if a user picks extreme values.

src/_r3f_isolated/stage-3d.jsx is intentionally kept as .jsx per the documented R3F v9 JSX-namespace-pollution constraint. No regression — data-testid='stage-3d-canvas' renders correctly with the new splGrid prop wired through.
429 Cloudflare rate-limits: 15 routes in sequence within ~1 min triggered the WAF. Not an app bug, but future testing agents should keep >=7s between goto() calls to stay under the rate.
updated_files: /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf — replaced '/usr/bin/pnpm dev' with '/app/node_modules/.bin/vite' because /usr/bin/pnpm resolves to corepack shim 11.15.0 which requires node:sqlite (Node 22+) and this env has Node 20.20.2, causing the frontend supervisor process to enter FATAL on start. Frontend now RUNNING and serving 200 on the public URL.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 2/2 new features PASS, 15/15 routes load with 0 app errors, 4/4 new testids resolve to sensible numeric values, slider reactivity PASS on both la-boxes and la-far, all iteration_1/2/3 regressions still PASS.

seed_data_creation: Used load-demo-btn to seed 'The Warehouse Club' room + PA gear for /stage-map 3D + SPL grid checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 introduces two physics modules exercised by 4 new testids: (a) /stage-map 3D view → spl-grid-max, spl-grid-uniformity (both under card labelled 'Predicción física ISO 9613'); (b) /toolkit → toolkit-tab-line-array → la-physical-spread, la-physical-uniform (under 'Predicción física J-Array (ISO 9613)'). Slider testids la-boxes / la-far are already reactive via React controlled inputs — when scripting slider drags, use the native HTMLInputElement.value setter + dispatchEvent('input', {bubbles:true}), or el.dispatchEvent alone will NOT trigger React state updates. Frontend supervisor is now started via /app/node_modules/.bin/vite (not pnpm) because Node 20 cannot host corepack pnpm 11 (needs node:sqlite). If the env is re-forked and pnpm reappears in supervisord.conf, expect FATAL and re-apply the same substitution. Cloudflare 429 rate-limits kick in around 6-7 rapid page navigations — put >=7s between goto() calls.
rca of the issue: N/A — no outstanding functional issues. Only environmental fix required: supervisor was pointed at /usr/bin/pnpm which is the corepack pnpm 11.15.0 shim; it fails on Node 20 because pnpm 11 depends on the built-in node:sqlite module introduced in Node 22. Root cause: env drift between the fork and the pinned Node version. Mitigation applied: run vite directly via /app/node_modules/.bin/vite in supervisord.conf.
